paper_title: The Safety Reminder A Soft Prompt to Reactivate Delayed Safety   Awareness in Vision-Language Models
caption: The proportion of harmful responses in which the model showed a rejection tendency.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio," which represents the proportion of harmful responses in which the model exhibited a rejection tendency, across four different vision-language models evaluated on two distinct benchmarks. The x-axis, labeled "Context Length" and presented on a linear scale, ranges from 128 to 1024, with tick labels at intervals of 128. The y-axis, labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio," is also on a linear scale and ranges from 0.0 to 0.5. The plot displays four distinct lines: the blue line with circular markers represents "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep," starting at approximately 0.20 and rising to about 0.36; the orange line with square markers represents "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep," starting at approximately 0.15 and rising to about 0.42; the green line with triangle markers represents "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench," starting at approximately 0.07 and rising to about 0.38; and the red line with diamond markers represents "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench," starting at approximately 0.24 and rising to about 0.51. All four lines show an increasing trend as context length increases, with the red line consistently having the highest ratio and the green line the lowest.
